question: Why do I feel lonely even when I have people around me?

evidence.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
evidence.translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

evidence.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
evidence.translation_en: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

evidence.arabic: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ
evidence.translation_en: And He is with you wherever you are.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّهُ سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, He is Hearing and Near.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُّجِيبٌ
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, my Lord is Near and Responsive.

sub_sections.heading: What does 'with us' mean in the Quran?

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا
evidence.translation_en: Indeed Allah is with us.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.

evidence.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ خَاشِعُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Successful indeed are the believers who are humble in their prayers.

evidence.arabic: أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
evidence.translation_en: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah?

evidence.arabic: أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ
evidence.translation_en: Competition in increase has diverted you, until you visit the graves.

evidence.arabic: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ
evidence.translation_en: And whoever turns away from the remembrance of the Most Merciful, We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.

evidence.arabic: وَلَا تُطِعْ مَنْ أَغْفَلْنَا قَلْبَهُ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ
evidence.translation_en: And do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire.

evidence.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ ۚ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
evidence.translation_en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.

evidence.arabic: ادْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
evidence.translation_en: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

evidence.arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
evidence.translation_en: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts find peace.

evidence.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيرًا
evidence.translation_en: O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance.

evidence.arabic: وَلَذِكْرُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ
evidence.translation_en: And the remembrance of Allah is greater.

sub_sections.heading: What does the Quran say about the heart?

evidence.arabic: وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
evidence.translation_en: And their hearts find peace in the remembrance of Allah.

evidence.arabic: فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَا
evidence.translation_en: Having hearts with which they understand.

evidence.arabic: فَمَن يُرِدِ اللَّهُ أَن يَهْدِيَهُ يَشْرَحْ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ
evidence.translation_en: So whoever Allah wants to guide, He expands his chest to Islam.

evidence.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا
evidence.translation_en: Indeed, those who have said, 'Our Lord is Allah' and then remained on a right course, the angels will descend upon them, 'Do not fear and do not grieve.'

evidence.arabic: لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا
evidence.translation_en: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.

evidence.arabic: أَلَا إِنَّ أَوْلِيَاءَ اللَّهِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
evidence.translation_en: Unquestionably, for the allies of Allah there will be no fear, nor will they grieve.

evidence.arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
evidence.translation_en: Say, 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.'

evidence.arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ
evidence.translation_en: So remember Me; I will remember you.
